title: Android SlidingDrawer: tracking events
purpose: Check the notifications for starting and ending drawer tracking, alongside the completed open and close events.
changes: The drawer now queues tracking-started and tracking-ended events. The example lists recent events below the drawer in their delivery order.
steps: Press and hold the drawer handle. While holding it, look below the drawer for Event: tracking started.
Release the handle. The list should add tracking ended, then opened when the drawer finishes moving.
Turn on Lock handle and use Close programmatically. The list should add tracking started, tracking ended, then closed.
Choose OK if it works, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: Tracking start and end are reported in order. The opened or closed event follows when the movement reaches its destination.
limits: For animated programmatic requests, Android reports start and end together when the request starts; they do not mean the animation has settled. Locking during an active drag is Bhoo-specific and Android device timing remains unverified.

references.scope: Tracking start/end and programmatic animation listener order.

validation: Twelve SlidingDrawer Rust tests and 157 XML importer tests passed, including tracking order, cancellation and lock interruption.
A 320 × 900 browser test checked held-handle and locked programmatic event order; open/close and nested demos also passed.
